enum _proxy_cfg_opcode_t

Proxy configuration opcodes. Use proxy_cfg_opcode_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Opcode to add an address to proxy configuration.

Opcode to remove an address from proxy configuration.

enumerator PROXY_CFG_OPCODE_FILTER_STAT

Opcode to get the filter status in proxy configuration.
